sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: Generative AI tools were used during development to assist with some 2D background artwork and decorative visual assets. All AI-assisted assets were reviewed and edited before inclusion. The game does not use generative AI during gameplay, and no player input or data is sent to generative AI services. Puzzles and answers are not generated by AI.
